objects.definition: using dim_t = int64_t;  // This type should be signed.
objects.description: Signed integer type used for tensor or dimension sizes within the ctranslate2 namespace. Alias of int64_t.

objects.definition: using float16_t = half_float::half;
objects.description: Half-precision (FP16) floating-point type alias referencing half_float::half, scoped in ctranslate2.
Enumeration of storage/data element types used for tensors and weights (float32, various ints, float16, bfloat16).

objects.definition:
enum class ComputeType {
    DEFAULT,
    AUTO,
    FLOAT32,
    INT8,
    INT8_FLOAT32,
    INT8_FLOAT16,
    INT8_BFLOAT16,
    INT16,
    FLOAT16,
    BFLOAT16,
  };
objects.description: Enumeration describing the computation precision/policy, including mixed-precision modes (e.g., INT8_FLOAT16) and device-dependent defaults.
Enumeration of supported execution devices. Values are CPU and CUDA. Used throughout the API to select the target device for operations.

RAII helper that temporarily sets the active device index for a given Device and restores the previous index on destruction. Construct with a target device and index; when the object goes out of scope, the prior index is restored.

RAII and utility class for initializing and finalizing MPI/NCCL-related process rank information. Constructor/destructor are declared here (definitions likely in source). Provides static accessors for world size, current rank, and local rank, and NCCL communicator when tensor parallelism is enabled. finalize() allows explicit teardown. Internal helper functions and communicator storage are compiled conditionally with CT2_WITH_TENSOR_PARALLEL.

objects.definition: using Shape = std::vector<dim_t>;
objects.description: Alias for a dynamic tensor shape represented as a vector of dimension sizes (dim_t). Used throughout StorageView to represent the extents of each axis.

A resizable, typed, device-aware view/wrapper over an allocated buffer that also tracks shape metadata. Supports construction from shapes, scalars, std::vector copies, and external buffers (views), plus device/dtype conversions, reshaping, resizing, and data access helpers. Allocation is aligned (per comments) and may be owned or viewed; ownership can be queried and memory can be reserved/released. Destructor implies resource cleanup via the configured allocator. Some template methods are only declared here and defined elsewhere.

Scoped enumeration of logging verbosity levels for the ctranslate2 library, ranging from completely disabled (Off) to very verbose tracing (Trace). Values are ordered by severity/verbosity. Used with set_log_level and get_log_level to control global logging behavior.
Standard C++ input file stream type returned by open_file_read. This header does not define it; it only references and returns it.
Standard C++ output file stream type returned by open_file_write. This header does not define it; it only references and returns it.
Standard C++ string type used as parameter. This header does not define it; it only references it.
Referenced from <random>; not defined here. Included to note that no custom types are defined. Ignore per instructions.

Abstract base class that defines an allocation interface for device-specific memory management within the ctranslate2 namespace. Provides pure-virtual methods to allocate and free memory on a given device index, plus a virtual clear_cache hook. Also supplies convenience overloads that default the device index to -1. Concrete subclasses are expected to implement allocate(size_t,int), free(void*,int), and optionally clear_cache().

Abstract base class representing an asynchronous job that can be executed by a worker. Subclasses must implement run(). It optionally tracks the number of active jobs via a shared atomic counter set with set_job_counter. Destruction and behavior details beyond this interface are not present in this header.

Thread-safe bounded queue for Job objects. put blocks when the queue is full; get blocks until a job is available and returns nullptr if the queue is closed. close requests shutdown/unblocking. Uses mutex and condition variables for synchronization. Maximum size is set at construction.

Worker running in its own thread to process jobs from a JobQueue. start launches the thread (with optional CPU affinity parameter), join waits for completion. Subclasses may override initialize/finalize hooks around the work loop and idle for behavior before waiting for new jobs.

Pool managing multiple worker threads that execute Job instances. Can construct with a number of default workers or with user-supplied Worker instances. Provides posting of jobs (blocking if queue is full), introspection of queued and active jobs, and access to workers. Maintains a shared JobQueue and an atomic active job counter.

Class that manages dynamic padding removal/addition on batched time-series tensors. It constructs index mappings between padded (batch, time) layout and a flattened, padding-free layout, and exposes methods to remove and restore padding. Static helper allow_padding_removal gates use based on device and compute type. Details about Device, ComputeType, StorageView, dim_t, and ops::Gather are external to this header.
direct_api_constructors: ctranslate2::Padder::Padder(const StorageView&, const dim_t, const dim_t)

objects.description: Helper class that marks tokens as disallowed in a batch of logits by setting their logit values to a very low score. On CPU it writes directly into the logits buffer; on GPU it collects unique flat indices and applies them later via apply(). Details such as StorageView, dim_t come from other headers and are not defined here.

Abstract base class for processing model output logits during decoding. Subclasses override apply() to modify logits or disable tokens based on decoding state. Provides helper methods to map beam indices to batch indices and to get the prefix length for a sample.

Concrete LogitsProcessor that applies a penalty to tokens that have already appeared in the generated sequence. The penalty factor is provided at construction. Exact application details are defined in the implementation file.
Concrete LogitsProcessor that prevents the generation of repeated n-grams of a given size by disabling tokens that would complete a previously seen n-gram.
Concrete LogitsProcessor that disables the generation of specific token sequences. Stores a flattened list of token IDs and the sequences to suppress. Exact matching behavior is defined elsewhere.
Concrete LogitsProcessor that disables the generation of a fixed set of token IDs at every step.
Concrete LogitsProcessor that disables a set of token IDs only at the first unconstrained decoding step.

Abstract base class in namespace ctranslate2 for sampling from a score distribution. Exposes a call operator that dispatches to a pure-virtual sample method implemented by subclasses. It expects scores as input and outputs sampled token IDs and their scores; outputs are required to be on CPU. Construction is via derived classes; there is no public constructor beyond the default and a virtual destructor.

Concrete Sampler that selects the best (e.g., highest-score) items from the score distribution. It final-overrides the sample method. No public constructors or fields are declared in this header; uses the implicit default constructor.

Concrete Sampler implementing stochastic sampling from a score distribution. Configurable with Top-K (from_topk), nucleus/Top-P (topp), and temperature; all have defaults. Owns three parameters as private fields. The sample method is final-overridden to perform random sampling according to these settings.

Container for the outputs of a decoding pass: per-sequence token hypotheses, optional sequence scores, optional attention weights, and optional per-step vocabulary logits. The StorageView type refers to tensors managed by ctranslate2.
Lightweight event object describing a single decoding step for a given batch/hypothesis, optionally carrying the step score and logits. Used by callback hooks during greedy search.
Abstract base class for decoding search algorithms. Subclasses implement search to generate output sequences given a decoder, state, and sampling/logits processing options.
Concrete SearchStrategy implementing beam search with optional length, coverage, and prefix-bias penalties and patience. Produces multiple hypotheses per input according to beam size.
Utility class that applies prefix biasing during decoding. It adjusts log-probabilities based on provided prefix token sequences, keeping an internal spare beam buffer.
Concrete SearchStrategy implementing greedy decoding. Optionally applies penalties for score parity with beam search and supports a per-step callback receiving DecodingStepResult.
Configuration struct for decoding, covering beam/sampling parameters, penalties, output controls, token/sequence disabling, logits processors, and an optional per-step callback.

Represents information for a single decoding step during text generation, including token id/text, optional score and logits, step index, and whether this was the last step. Provides a convenience constructor to build from a DecodingStepResult and a Vocabulary. Ownership and lifetime of optional logits (StorageView) follow StorageView semantics in included headers; details not specified here.

Options controlling text generation and decoding behavior (beam search, sampling, penalties, constraints, outputs). Includes an optional callback invoked per generated token in greedy search, which can stop generation early by returning true.

Holds the outputs of a generation request: token sequences as strings and ids, optional hypothesis scores, and optional per-step logits (as StorageView matrices). Provides helpers to query number of sequences and whether scores are present.

Functor that resolves end token specifications to vocabulary ids using a provided Vocabulary. Accepts a single token string, a vector of token strings, or a vector of ids, returning a vector of ids. An empty string maps to the EOS id.

Struct that groups the outputs of an encoder forward pass: a mandatory last_hidden_state tensor and an optional pooler_output tensor. Both tensors are represented with StorageView; pooler_output may be absent. Exact semantics of StorageView are defined elsewhere.

Holds special-token configuration for a vocabulary: unknown, beginning-of-sequence, and end-of-sequence tokens. Defaults are <unk>, <s>, and </s>. Used to parameterize Vocabulary behavior and ID lookups.

Implements a standard indexed vocabulary mapping between tokens and ids with configurable special tokens. Supports construction from token lists or serialized text/JSON streams, membership testing, single and batched conversions, and accessors for special tokens and their ids. Internally stores id-to-token pointers and a token-to-id map; owns a VocabularyInfo copy. Destruction/ownership follow standard C++ object semantics; no custom deleter is declared.

Class that loads a vocabulary mapping from a text stream mapping n-grams to lists of target token IDs, and provides a method to compute an ordered set of candidate target token IDs given source token sequences and an optional target prefix. Internally stores the vocabulary size, a set of fixed candidate IDs, and mapping rules from string n-grams to candidate ID vectors. Construction requires a stream of the mapping file and a Vocabulary object (declared in vocabulary.h). Destructor/ownership semantics are default; no special destruction requirements are indicated.

Configuration options for sequence scoring. Controls maximum input length truncation and a decoding/scoring offset. The exact meaning of dim_t and how offset interacts with the decoder is not documented here.
Holds the per-token tokens and their scores for a scored sequence, with helpers to compute cumulative and length-normalized scores.
Enumeration selecting the batching policy: by number of examples or by number of tokens.
A container for one training/decoding example, holding one or more token streams (e.g., source and target). Provides helpers to count streams and per-stream length.
Abstract base class that produces batches of Example objects. Derived classes implement get_next_example(). Provides get_next() utility and internal batching helpers.
Concrete BatchReader that iterates over a preloaded collection of Example objects or raw sequences, exposing them one by one.
BatchReader that multiplexes multiple BatchReader sources. Supports adding child readers and reading merged examples in parallel order.
Represents a processed batch: a set of Example objects plus their original indices. Provides utilities to query emptiness/size and to extract a specific stream across examples.

Class that wraps a Translator to buffer incoming translation requests and flush them either after a timeout or when the buffer reaches a size threshold. It likely spawns a background thread to aggregate requests and submit batched translations. Construction requires an existing Translator, batch sizing, a timeout, optional translation options, and an optional explicit max buffer size. Exact semantics of TranslationOptions, Example, and TranslationResult are defined elsewhere.

Configuration for a pool of parallel model replicas. Controls per-replica thread count, maximum queued batches, and optional CPU core offset for thread pinning. Defaults: 0 threads (use global/default), 0 max queued batches (auto = 4×workers), and -1 CPU core offset (no specific offset).

16-bit Brain Floating Point (bfloat16) storage/utility class in namespace ctranslate2. It stores the raw 16-bit payload and provides implicit conversion from/to float with rounding-to-nearest-even for normal values, sign-preserving zero for subnormals/zero, propagation for infinities, and quiet-NaN enforcement for NaNs. Intended as a lightweight value type; no dynamic resources. Construction: default-initialized (uninitialized _bits) or from float; assignable from float; convertible to float. Note: no public access to raw bits and no arithmetic/operators beyond conversion; use via conversion. Destruction has no special requirements.
Strongly typed enumeration describing the quantization method used by models: default CTranslate2 scheme (CT2), or AWQ variants for GEMM or GEMV backends.

Abstract base class for CTranslate2 models. Manages device placement, compute type, variables, quantization method, and provides loading, cloning, and conversion to specific replica interfaces. Users obtain instances via the static load functions; derived classes must implement clone and may override various hooks for variable handling and initialization.
direct_api_constructors: ctranslate2::models::Model::load(const std::string&, Device, int, ComputeType, bool, bool)

objects.description: Helper class to load one or more replicas of the same model across devices. Holds configuration (device, indices, compute_type, etc.) and exposes load() to return shared model instances per device.

Base class for runtime replicas that colocate execution resources with a model. Stores a shared pointer to the associated Model and exposes it via model(). Intended to be subclassed by specific replica types.

objects.definition: class SequenceToSequenceReplica;
objects.description: Forward-declared replica interface for sequence-to-sequence models. Only a declaration appears here; behavior is defined elsewhere.

objects.definition: class SequenceGeneratorReplica;
objects.description: Forward-declared replica interface for sequence generation models. Only a declaration appears here; behavior is defined elsewhere.

objects.definition: class SequenceEncoderReplica;
objects.description: Forward-declared replica interface for sequence encoders. Only a declaration appears here; behavior is defined elsewhere.

Abstract interface for reading model files from a source (disk, memory, etc.). Provides a model identifier, a method to open a file as a stream, and a helper that throws if the file cannot be opened. Intended as an extension point for custom storage backends.
Concrete ModelReader that reads model files from a directory on disk. Stores the root model directory and implements model identification and file access from that directory.
Concrete ModelReader that serves model files from in-memory content. Files can be registered by name and retrieved as input streams. Useful for embedding models or testing without filesystem access.

Singleton factory class in namespace ctranslate2::models that registers named model builders and creates model instances by name. It stores a registry mapping strings to builder callables that construct std::shared_ptr<models::Model>. Provides get_instance(), a templated register_model, and create_model. Ownership: the factory owns the registry; created models are returned as shared_ptr. Destruction is default. Thread-safety is not specified.

objects.definition: using Builder = std::function<std::shared_ptr<models::Model>(void)>;
objects.description: Type alias inside ModelFactory for a callable that, when invoked with no arguments, returns a std::shared_ptr<ctranslate2::models::Model>. Used as the value type stored in the registry map.

objects.definition: std::unordered_map<std::string, Builder> _registry;
objects.description: Private data member of ModelFactory mapping model names to builder callables that construct models. Not a standalone named type beyond the member declaration.

Abstract sequence-to-sequence model interface derived from Model. Exposes accessors for source/target vocabularies and optional vocabulary map, as well as configuration flags for special tokens and decoder start token. Holds shared ownership of vocabularies and initializes them via a ModelReader. Implementation details (e.g., initialize, vocabulary loading) are defined elsewhere.

Abstract runtime replica for sequence-to-sequence models derived from ModelReplica. Provides high-level score and translate APIs with hook methods to skip operations and pure-virtual backends run_scoring/run_translation to be implemented by concrete replicas. Includes a static helper to create a seq2seq replica from a Model.

Concrete SequenceToSequenceReplica that couples a SequenceToSequenceModel with encoder and decoder layer implementations. Implements translation/scoring logic, provides accessors to underlying encoder/decoder, and owns them via unique_ptr while holding a shared_ptr to the model.

Abstract base and derived classes for CTranslate2 language modeling. LanguageModel extends Model, holding a Vocabulary and a thread-safe DecoderStateCache. SequenceGeneratorReplica is an abstract replica for generative LMs with scoring, generation, and forward methods; DecoderReplica implements sequence generation using a layers::Decoder. SequenceEncoderReplica is an abstract replica for sequence encoders; EncoderReplica implements encoding with layers::Encoder and optional pooling. Construction/destruction details are not present in this header; semantics are inferred from class names and members.

Concrete model classes for transformer architectures within ctranslate2::models. TransformerModel is a sequence-to-sequence model with configurable number of attention heads and overrides hooks for variable registration, initialization, packing, and cloning. Details of storage and reader types are defined elsewhere. The exact construction semantics beyond the constructor argument are not documented here.

Decoder-only Transformer language model specialization. Provides a generator replica, declares initialization and cloning interfaces, and a filter for linear weights. No additional state is defined in this header.
Encoder-only Transformer language model specialization. Exposes creation of a sequence encoder replica and overrides linear-weight filtering and cloning. No fields are declared here.

Options structure for controlling Wav2Vec2 decoding/sampling behavior such as maximum length, top-k sampling, timestamp constraints, blank suppression, and token suppression. Defaults are provided. Exact interpretation may depend on model configuration; details beyond field comments are not present here.

Model class for Wav2Vec2 in CTranslate2. Provides vocabulary access, spec revision, quantization/weight type checks, cloning, and initialization from a ModelReader. Holds a shared vocabulary. Global int16 scaling is disabled.

Executable replica of a Wav2Vec2Model bound to runtime resources. It owns an encoder and can encode feature tensors, optionally transferring results to CPU. Constructed either via the static factory or by passing a shared Wav2Vec2Model.
High-level pool managing multiple Wav2Vec2Replica instances for parallel inference. Exposes an asynchronous encode method returning a future of StorageView.

Options struct carrying generation and decoding parameters for Wav2Vec2-BERT style models, including max output length, top-k sampling, timestamp control, blank suppression, and a list of token IDs to suppress. Exact semantics may depend on model implementation details not shown here.

Concrete model class for Wav2Vec2-BERT in CTranslate2. Exposes vocabulary access, spec revision, quantization properties, and cloning. Holds a shared Vocabulary and initializes from a ModelReader. The body/definitions are not present in this header.

A per-replica runnable instance of the Wav2Vec2BertModel. Owns an encoder and provides encode() to transform input features, optionally moving results to CPU. Constructed from a Wav2Vec2BertModel via constructor or the static create_from_model().
A pool manager for Wav2Vec2BertReplica instances, enabling concurrent inference. Forwards encode requests asynchronously and returns a future over StorageView.
Configuration struct controlling Whisper decoding behavior (beam search, sampling, penalties, result content, and token suppression). Used as input options for generation APIs.
Result container for Whisper generation. Holds token sequences (as strings and ids), optional scores, optional per-token logits per timestep, and the no-speech probability.
Alignment output container mapping text token indices to frame indices, with per-token probabilities.

Concrete Whisper model metadata/weights container derived from Model. Exposes vocabulary access and model-specific capability flags. Initialization and cloning are overridden. Construction details are not provided in this header.

Executable replica of a WhisperModel providing encode, generate, language detection, and alignment on a specific device/thread context. Manages encoder/decoder layers and vocabulary/token ids. Constructed from a WhisperModel.
High-level pool managing multiple WhisperReplica instances for concurrent requests. Provides asynchronous encode, generation, language detection, and alignment interfaces returning futures.
Abstract base class for neural network layers in ctranslate2::layers. It defines the interface for querying the output data type and size. Derived classes implement inference operators and specifics.
Word/token embedding lookup layer loading parameters from a Model scope. Applies a gather over an embedding matrix, optionally with quantization scaling.
Enumeration controlling how multiple embedding outputs are merged: concatenation or elementwise addition. Order is fixed for serialization/compatibility.
Composite layer holding multiple Embeddings instances and merging their outputs according to EmbeddingsMerge. Loads sublayers from a model scope prefix.
Abstract base class for layers that add or return positional encodings. Provides call operators that apply positional information using an encoding buffer provided by get_position_encoding.
Position encoder that uses precomputed positional embedding vectors loaded from the model under a given scope.
Position encoder that computes sinusoidal encodings on demand and caches them in an internal StorageView. Compatible with OpenNMT-tf formulation.
Fully connected layer with optional activation and quantization support. Weights/bias are loaded from the model; can select a subset of weights for specialized inference paths.
Layer normalization layer using gamma (scale) and optional beta (bias), with configurable epsilon and potential residual usage flag.
1D convolution layer with optional bias and quantization scaling. Construction reads weights from the model scope; operator() applies convolution with given stride/padding/dilation/groups.

Multi-head attention layer implementation that derives from AttentionLayer. Provides forward operator for self- or cross-attention, optional positional mechanisms (relative bias/keys/values, rotary embeddings, ALiBi), and optional query/key normalization. Members indicate internal caching, head splitting/combining, and padding-aware processing. Some members referenced (_rotary_embeddings, _alibi) are not declared here, implying they are inherited or defined elsewhere. Construction requires a Model, scope, head count, and flags for self-attention, pre-norm, decoder mode, and optional ALiBi pointer.

Abstract attention layer interface supporting self/cross attention, caching, masking, positional biases (rotary embeddings, ALiBi), and optional FlashAttention. Constructed with model, scope, head configuration, and flags. Provides a pure-virtual call operator to run attention and a static utility to build length masks.

Implements rotary positional embeddings with optional scaling strategies and caching of sine/cosine tensors. Provides apply() to in-place apply embeddings to a tensor, accessors for cached half-precision buffers, and configuration for interleaving and scaling. Internal buffers are lazily initialized via initialize().
Implements ALiBi positional bias generation and application to attention scores. Configurable sign convention and scaling; caches generated bias in _alibi and applies it via an internal op.
Enumeration of rotary embedding scaling strategies: None, Linear, Su, Llama3. Used to configure RotaryEmbeddings behavior.

Abstract base class for encoder layers in ctranslate2. It inherits from Layer (defined elsewhere) and defines a family of call operators to run the encoder on input token ids and optional sequence lengths, writing results to an output StorageView. The main customization point for derived encoders is the protected pure-virtual operator() that accepts a vector of input feature StorageViews, an optional lengths pointer, and an output StorageView. num_input_features() indicates how many parallel input feature streams are expected (default 1). Construction and destruction details are not specified in this header; implementers must derive and implement the protected operator().

Position-wise feed-forward sublayer used in Transformer blocks. It optionally applies pre-layer normalization and supports different activation functions. Internally composed of Dense layers (with optional no-activation variant) and an optional LayerNorm. Exact tensor shapes and parameter initialization are defined elsewhere.

A single Transformer encoder block combining self-attention, feed-forward network, and optional layer normalizations. Supports pre-norm or post-norm configurations and optional flash attention. Provides output type/size via its feed-forward submodule.

A Transformer decoder block with masked self-attention, optional encoder-decoder cross-attention, and a feed-forward network. Supports caching of attention keys/values for incremental decoding, optional flash attention, and Alibi position bias. Provides helpers to query presence of cross-attention and access self-attention module.

Full Transformer encoder stack. Owns input embeddings and a sequence of TransformerEncoderLayer blocks, with optional embedding/output layer norms, position encoding, and flash attention. Processes token id features into encoded representations.

Full Transformer decoder stack for autoregressive generation. Manages embeddings, position encoding, optional projection layers, alignment head control, and a sequence of TransformerDecoderLayer blocks. Provides step-wise and batched decoding entry points and exposes the output projection layer.

Feature-extraction sublayer combining 1D convolution, transpose, GELU activation, and layer normalization for Wav2Vec 2.0 front-end. Exposes output_type and output_size via the underlying Conv1D. Construction parameters indicate stride and padding for temporal subsampling. Destruction and lifecycle are standard C++ class semantics; no special cleanup noted.

Positional convolution embedding layer for Wav2Vec 2.0. Applies a 1D convolution with GELU and transpose to produce position-enriched features. Output type/size delegated to Conv1D. Standard RAII; no explicit destruction details provided.

Full Wav2Vec 2.0 encoder stack orchestrating feature projection, optional convolutional front-end, positional convolution embedding, multi-head Transformer encoder layers, and an optional LM head. Provides helper methods for input/output size, output type/size resolution, and a heuristic to detect whether features are already encoded. Owns/contains multiple sublayers and parameters; lifetime is managed by standard C++ semantics.

Transformer-style encoder layer specialized for Wav2Vec2/BERT-like models. It encapsulates self-attention, feed-forward sublayers, multiple layer norms, and several 1D conv and activation ops. The exact wiring is not fully documented in this header; usage is to construct with a Model and scope and call operator() to transform input to output. Details such as shapes and normalization strategy depend on constructor flags (pre_norm, activation, flash attention).

Adapter layer that augments or downsamples features between encoder blocks. It combines residual and attention paths with 1D convolutions, layer norms, and a feed-forward network. Construct with a Model and scope and call operator() to transform inputs. Specific topology is inferred but not fully described in this header.

High-level encoder that stacks EncoderLayer and AdapterLayer blocks to process Wav2Vec2 features into BERT-like representations. Provides shape helpers (input_size, output_size) and optional LM head. Use operator() to run the encoder. Some behavioral details (e.g., when _lm_head is present, semantics of _return_logits) are not documented here.

Encoder class for Whisper-style audio features. Applies two Conv1D layers with GELU and transpose, adds position embeddings, runs a stack of TransformerEncoderLayer blocks, and finishes with LayerNorm. Provides shape- and type-query utilities and an operator() to encode features. Construction requires a models::Model and scope. Exact internal algorithm details for forward are not shown in this header.

Decoder class specialized for Whisper. Inherits TransformerDecoder and disables normalized attention outputs. Exposes methods to encode a prompt into DecoderState and to compute logits for specific time steps from decoder outputs. Construction reuses TransformerDecoder constructors via using-declaration. Implementation details are not present here.

Attention layer implementation using a flash multi-head attention kernel. Provides an operator() to run attention given queries/values and optional caches/padders, and utility methods to split/combine heads. Owns an internal cache-time dimension and uses a fixed offset free space constant. Details such as internal fields like _rotary_embeddings and _alibi are referenced but not defined in this header; their semantics suggest optional positional biasing (rotary embeddings or ALiBi).

No custom data types are defined in this header. It only contains include directives and a pragma once guard. Therefore, there are no structs, enums, typedefs, or classes to document from this file itself.

Abstract base class for operator objects in ctranslate2::ops. It provides a virtual destructor enabling polymorphic deletion. Derived classes implement concrete operator applications (unary/binary/ternary).

Abstract base class for unary operators. Requires derived classes to implement a call operator taking one input StorageView and producing one output StorageView. No implementation details are provided here; it serves as an interface.
Abstract base class for binary operators. Enforces a call operator that consumes two input StorageView arguments and writes to one output StorageView. Acts as an interface only.

Abstract base class for ternary operators. Requires derived classes to implement a call operator that takes three input StorageView references and produces one output StorageView. Interface only; no construction utilities are defined here.

This header only aggregates other headers and defines no custom types itself. There are no structs, enums, typedefs, or classes explicitly defined here. All types are defined in the included headers and are out of scope for this extraction.

Strongly-typed enumeration of activation function kinds used within ctranslate2::ops. The order is documented as fixed, implying external dependencies (e.g., serialization or table indexing) may rely on the exact ordinal values. Values include ReLU, several GELU variants, Swish, Tanh, and Sigmoid. No additional behavior is defined in this header beyond the enum members.

Binary element-wise Add operation type within ctranslate2::ops. It derives from BinaryOp (declared in op.h) and defines a call operator to add two StorageView tensors, handling both scalar and tensor rhs. The private templated compute method selects device and value type and uses primitives<D>::add to perform the addition, resizing the output to match the first input. Construction details are not specified; it is a concrete op that can be instantiated directly. Destruction behavior is standard for a polymorphic class; no custom resources indicated.

Binary operation class that adds an ALiBi (Attention Linear Bias) tensor to an input tensor. It exposes a call operator to perform the operation and a templated compute helper for specific device/type backends. The constructor allows choosing whether to use positive positions for the bias. Details about BinaryOp, StorageView, Device, and dim_t are not defined in this header. Construction is via the provided constructor; there are no special destruction requirements indicated.

A binary operation class that adds a bias tensor to an input value tensor, optionally followed by an activation. It derives from BinaryOp (declared elsewhere). The constructor accepts an optional ActivationType pointer specifying which activation to apply; if null, no activation is applied. The call operator performs the operation and dispatches to a templated compute implementation over device and element type. Details about StorageView, Device, ActivationType, and BinaryOp are referenced but defined in other headers.

Concatenation operator class in the ctranslate2::ops namespace. It derives from Op and performs concatenation of multiple StorageView tensors along a specified axis provided at construction. The call operator executes the operation; a templated private compute method handles device- and type-specific implementations. Details about Op, StorageView, Device, and T are referenced from other headers and not defined here.

1D convolution operator class in the ctranslate2::ops namespace. It derives from Op and encapsulates stride, padding, dilation, and groups for convolution. Provides call operators to run convolution with or without bias and optional quantization scale. Internal helpers include a templated compute path, a GEMM-based implementation, and an im2col transformation. Exact tensor types (StorageView), device enum (Device), and scalar type (dim_t) are referenced but defined elsewhere.

Unary operation class implementing cosine. It derives from UnaryOp and defines a call operator that computes y = cos(x) over a StorageView input into an output StorageView. The exact semantics of broadcasting, dtype support, and in-place behavior are not documented here and depend on UnaryOp and StorageView definitions in included headers.

An operation object that performs dequantization. It can dequantize a tensor using a scale tensor or rescale an int32 GEMM output to float32 using per-input scales. It optionally applies an activation determined by the provided ActivationType pointer. Construction accepts an optional ActivationType pointer; ownership/lifetime of the ActivationType is not defined here and likely external. The two call operators provide the public API. Details of supported devices/types are implemented in the private templated helpers.

FlashAttention is an operator class implementing a fast attention kernel within ctranslate2::ops. It derives from Op (declared in op.h). Constructed with scaling of queries, an optional sliding window size, and a causality flag. It exposes a call operator to run attention with optional cache, attention output, rotary embeddings, ALiBi bias, and an offset. Internal state is immutable after construction. The actual compute is performed by a templated private method specialized per Device. Destruction/ownership is standard C++ (no custom deleter).

A binary operation class implementing a gather operation over a specified axis with optional batch dimensions. It derives from BinaryOp (declared elsewhere) and exposes call operators to perform in-place or out-of-place gather. It stores immutable configuration parameters _axis and _batch_dims, and a templated compute helper for device/type-specialized execution. Details of BinaryOp, StorageView, Device, and dim_t are not defined in this header.

GELU unary operation class implementing the Gaussian Error Linear Unit activation within ctranslate2::ops. It applies GELU to an input StorageView and writes results to an output StorageView. Behavior can be configured via an internal Approximation mode (exact, tanh-based, or sigmoid-based). Construction takes an Approximation value and the call operator performs the computation, dispatching to backend primitives. Ownership: no explicit owners known from this header; it is a concrete UnaryOp.

Enumeration of approximation modes for the GELU operation: None (exact), Tanh (tanh-based approximation), and Sigmoid (sigmoid-based approximation). It is a nested enum class inside ctranslate2::ops::GELU.

Matrix multiplication operator (GEMM) within ctranslate2::ops. Encapsulates parameters alpha/beta scaling, transpose flags, and whether inputs are already packed. Optionally applies a bias and activation during the GEMM. Provides static helpers to pack the B matrix and to compute compensation terms for unsigned/signed int8 backends. Details of Op, StorageView, ActivationType, Device, and dim_t are referenced from other headers and not defined here.

A concrete Op that performs Gumbel-max sampling on input scores/tensor. It stores the number of samples to draw and internally uses a TopK operator. Provides call operators to compute sampled values and indices or only indices. Template helper add_gumbel_noise adds Gumbel noise for a given Device and element type. Details about Op, StorageView, TopK, dim_t, Device are external and not defined here.

Unary operation class that implements an identity transform: assigns output y to be equal to input x. It derives from UnaryOp (defined elsewhere) and overrides the call operator to copy the input StorageView into the output. No additional state is stored.

Layer normalization operation class in the ctranslate2::ops namespace. It derives from TernaryOp and exposes several operator() overloads to apply layer normalization to an input tensor, optionally with beta (bias) and gamma (scale) tensors. The constructor configures the normalization axis and epsilon used for numerical stability. Private helpers include a pointer-based dispatcher overload and a templated compute implementation. Fields _axis and _epsilon store configuration. Details about TernaryOp, StorageView, Device, and dim_t are not defined in this header and are assumed to come from included headers.

Unary operation class implementing elementwise natural logarithm on a StorageView tensor. It exposes a call operator to apply the op and a templated compute helper that dispatches to primitives<D>::log for a given device and scalar type. Details about UnaryOp, StorageView, Device, and primitives are not defined in this header and are assumed to come from op.h. Construction/destruction specifics are not provided; typical usage is to instantiate Log and call operator() with input/output StorageView objects.

Matrix multiplication operation class in ctranslate2::ops. It represents a binary operator that multiplies two StorageView tensors with optional transposition of each input and a scaling factor alpha. It exposes a call operator to perform the computation and a templated compute helper for specific Device/element type. Construction parameters control behavior; destruction/ownership follow standard C++ semantics. Details of BinaryOp, StorageView, Device, and execution semantics are referenced from included headers and not defined here.

Unary operation class that computes the mean along a specified axis. It stores the target axis (_axis) and exposes an operator() to apply the op to an input StorageView and write to an output StorageView. A protected templated compute method provides device- and type-specific implementation details. Exact semantics of UnaryOp, StorageView, Device, and dim_t are defined elsewhere.

MedianFilter is an operation class derived from Op that applies a median filter to an input tensor-like StorageView and writes the result to an output StorageView. It stores the filter window width (_width). The actual computation is implemented in a templated compute method specialized by device and value type. Construction requires a width; usage invokes the call operator with input and output. Destruction and ownership follow typical C++ semantics; no explicit resource management is visible here.

Binary operation class implementing elementwise minimum between two StorageView tensors. If the second operand is a scalar, it applies a scalar-vs-tensor min; otherwise, it performs elementwise min. Uses device- and type-specialized primitives via the private compute template. The exact BinaryOp and StorageView interfaces come from op.h.

Binary operation class implementing elementwise maximum between two StorageView tensors. If the second operand is a scalar, it applies a scalar-vs-tensor max; otherwise, it performs elementwise max. Uses device- and type-specialized primitives via the private compute template. The exact BinaryOp and StorageView interfaces come from op.h.

Binary element-wise multiplication operation class in ctranslate2::ops. Mul overrides operator() to multiply inputs a and b into c. It includes a templated compute helper specialized by Device and element type T, handling both scalar-broadcast multiply and element-wise multiply. Details of BinaryOp, StorageView, Device, and primitives are not defined here and come from included headers. Construction/destruction specifics are not provided in this header; usage is via calling operator()(a, b, c) on an existing Mul instance.

Unary operation class that performs multinomial sampling with replacement over an input distribution. It stores a configurable sample size and exposes a call operator to execute the sampling. Details about UnaryOp, StorageView, Device, dim_t, and the expected input/output tensor layout are not defined in this header; they are presumed to come from op.h. The class provides an internal dispatch method and a templated compute implementation specialized by device and data type.

An operation object that reduces all elements of the input tensor into a single value using the specified reduction operator (sum, product, min, max, or average). The chosen reduction is stored in the _reduce_op member and passed at construction. Details about StorageView, Device, and Op are defined elsewhere.
Scoped enum defining the reduction operator used by ReduceAll: sum, product, minimum, maximum, or average.

An operation object that gathers all elements from the input tensor into the output. The exact gathering semantics are not documented in this header; likely consolidates or flattens the input across dimensions or devices. Depends on Op, StorageView, and Device defined elsewhere.

Quantize is an operation class deriving from Op that performs numeric quantization on a StorageView. It supports configurable scale behavior via the nested ScaleType and options to shift outputs to uint8 and to round before casting. It exposes a call operator to apply quantization and a templated private helper for device/type-specialized implementations. Some details (exact algorithm, valid input/output dtypes, and value ranges) are not specified in this header.

Strongly-typed enum inside Quantize selecting the scaling granularity for int16 quantization: a single global scale, per-layer scale, or per-row scale. Actual interpretation is per the Quantize implementation.

Rectified Linear Unit operation class in the ctranslate2::ops namespace. It derives from UnaryOp and applies an elementwise ReLU to the input StorageView, writing results to the output StorageView. The public call operator dispatches to a templated compute helper that resizes the output like the input and invokes primitives<D>::relu on the underlying data. Construction details are not provided in this header; usage is via calling operator()(x, y). Ownership/lifecycle follows that of a typical polymorphic op; specifics about destruction or additional state are unknown from this header.

RMSNorm operation object implementing root-mean-square normalization. Constructed with an epsilon for numerical stability and an option to use residual normalization. It is an Op subclass that applies normalization via operator() given gamma (scale), input, and writes to output. The internal compute method is templated on Device and element type. Destruction and copy semantics follow standard C++ class rules; no special lifetime management indicated.

A custom operation class implementing rotary position embedding application. It stores the number of rotary dimensions (ndims) and whether to interleave dimensions. The call operator applies the rotary transform to an input tensor using provided sine and cosine tensors, optionally handling transposed layout. Construction requires ndims and interleave; destruction/ownership follow base Op semantics. Details of compute are template-based over Device and element type T.

Unary operation class implementing the Sigmoid activation. It overrides operator() to apply the elementwise sigmoid to input tensor x and write results to y. Internally provides a templated compute method parameterized by device and scalar type, resizing y to match x and invoking primitives<D>::sigmoid on the raw data pointers. Details of UnaryOp, StorageView, Device, and primitives are external to this header.

Unary operation class implementing the sine function over a StorageView input. It inherits from UnaryOp, implying elementwise application: y = sin(x). Only the call operator is declared here; implementation details are not provided in this header.

Slide is an Op that extracts or copies a contiguous window (a "slide") from an input tensor along a given axis. It stores the axis, starting index, and window size, with an option to avoid copying when possible. The class provides a call operator to execute the operation, internal argument validation, and a templated compute path specialized by device and element type. Detailed semantics (e.g., bounds behavior and no-copy conditions) are not documented here and must be inferred from implementation in the corresponding source file.

SoftMax is a unary operation class implementing softmax on a StorageView tensor, optionally in log-space. It provides multiple operator() overloads to compute in-place, to a provided output, and with optional sequence lengths for masking. It stores a flag _log to toggle log-softmax behavior and a templated compute implementation for specific device and type. Details of UnaryOp, StorageView, Device, and memory semantics are defined elsewhere.

LogSoftMax is a convenience subclass of SoftMax that constructs the operation to compute log-softmax. It likely sets the internal _log flag via its constructor. No additional methods beyond construction are defined here.

Class implementing a tensor split operation within ctranslate2::ops. It splits an input StorageView along a specified axis, optionally according to provided split sizes, and writes results into 2, 3, or a vector of output StorageView pointers. The no_copy flag hints whether the implementation may avoid copying when possible. Details of Op, StorageView, Device, and dim_t are external to this header. Construction is via the provided constructors; internal state tracks axis, per-chunk sizes, total size, and copy policy. Destruction/ownership follow regular C++ object semantics.

Unary tensor operation that removes size-1 dimensions at the specified axes from a tensor shape. It sorts the provided axes on construction and validates that each targeted dimension equals 1; otherwise it throws std::invalid_argument. Provides operator() overloads to operate in-place on a StorageView or to write into an output StorageView via shallow copy followed by reshape. Lifecycle specifics (ownership, threading, exceptions beyond invalid_argument) are not documented here and depend on the surrounding ops framework in op.h.

Binary subtraction operation class within ctranslate2::ops. It overrides the BinaryOp call operator to compute elementwise subtraction c = a - b. The private templated compute method dispatches to primitives<D>::sub for either scalar-broadcast subtraction (when b is a scalar) or elementwise subtraction, and resizes the output to match a. Details about BinaryOp, StorageView, Device, primitives, and data types are defined elsewhere and are not included here.

A reduction operation class that computes the sum along a specified axis. It derives from Mean, sharing the same interface for applying the operation on StorageView tensors. The constructor accepts an axis (dim_t). Details about behavior (e.g., axis semantics, broadcasting, data types) follow the base class Mean and surrounding ops framework but are not documented in this header.

Class implementing the Swish activation as a unary operation within ctranslate2::ops. It overrides operator()(x, y) to compute y = swish(x). Internally provides a templated compute routine that resizes the output to match the input and calls primitives<D>::swish over x's data. Exact details of UnaryOp, StorageView, Device, and primitives are defined elsewhere.

Unary operation class implementing the hyperbolic tangent (tanh) elementwise transform. It inherits from UnaryOp and defines a call operator that takes an input StorageView and writes results to an output StorageView. Exact behavior, construction, and lifecycle details are not documented here; only the interface is present.

Tile is a unary operation class that repeats (tiles) an input tensor along a specified axis a given number of times. It stores the tiling axis and tile count and provides call operators to perform the operation, with an internal templated compute method specialized by device and element type. Details about UnaryOp, StorageView, Device, dim_t are external to this header.

TopK operation class implementing a k-selection over an input tensor. It derives from Op and exposes a call operator to compute top-k values and their indices along a specified axis. Internals include a stored k value and a templated compute implementation for different devices and data/index types. Details about Op, StorageView, Device, dim_t are external to this header.

Top-p (nucleus) masking operation class. Given input scores or probabilities, it produces an output where values outside the smallest cumulative-probability mass ≥ p are set to mask_value (typically -inf), enabling nucleus sampling. It stores the threshold p and the mask value. Details such as exact input expectations (logits vs probabilities) and dtype handling are not documented here and must be inferred from the operator() and compute templates in the implementation file.

Unary tensor operation that permutes dimensions of an input tensor into an output tensor. It supports ranks 2, 3, and 4. The constructor can take a permutation vector; at call time, operator() dispatches to backend primitives based on rank. The internal template compute method handles resizing the destination and invoking rank-specific transpose primitives. Details about UnaryOp, StorageView, Device, dim_t, and primitives are external and not defined in this header.

Unary tensor operation that inserts singleton dimensions (of size 1) at the specified axes of the input shape. The constructor captures and sorts the target axes. The call operators reshape the provided StorageView in-place or copy-reshape into an output StorageView. Details of UnaryOp, StorageView, Shape, and PROFILE are not defined here.

A matrix multiplication operator variant (AWQ: activation-aware/affine weight quantization) extending Gemm. It defines a call operator that multiplies matrices a and b using per-weight scale and zero-point tensors to dequantize/quantize and writes the result into c, optionally adding a bias. The implementation details are not provided in this header. Construction uses the base Gemm constructors via using Gemm::Gemm.

Class implementing a GEMV (matrix-vector) operation for AWQ (activation-aware weight quantization) on top of Gemm. Provides a call operator to perform the computation, and private templated helpers for device- and type-specific implementations. Construction follows Gemm's constructors via 'using Gemm::Gemm'. Details about members, lifetime, and specific behavior depend on the Gemm base class and StorageView API, which are not defined in this header.

A concrete Op implementing dequantization for AWQ (activation-aware weight quantization). Provides a call operator to dequantize an input tensor using per-some-granularity scale and zero tensors into an output StorageView. Internally dispatches to a templated dequantize implementation specialized by device (Device) and input/output element types. Specific behavior, supported devices, and expected tensor shapes are not documented in this header and must be inferred from the surrounding library.

Configuration structure for translation/decoding behavior in ctranslate2. Holds beam search, sampling, constraints, return options, and a per-step callback. It is a plain aggregate with default member initializers; no constructors or special ownership semantics are defined here. Some referenced types (GenerationStepResult) are declared elsewhere.

Result container for a translation request. Stores N-best hypotheses and optional scores, attention, and logits. Provides convenience accessors and multiple constructors to build empty, partially-initialized, or fully-initialized results. Members use standard containers; StorageView is defined elsewhere.

High-level class encapsulating parallel and asynchronous text generation using language models. It derives from ReplicaPool<models::SequenceGeneratorReplica>, so it manages a pool of generator replicas to run batched requests concurrently. This header only declares the interface; constructor behavior and lifecycle are inherited from ReplicaPool via using ReplicaPool::ReplicaPool. Details about GenerationResult, ScoringResult, StorageView, GenerationOptions, ScoringOptions, BatchType, and models::SequenceGeneratorReplica are referenced but not defined here.

High-level class in namespace ctranslate2 that provides asynchronous batch encoding utilities over a pool of SequenceEncoderReplica workers. It derives from ReplicaPool<models::SequenceEncoderReplica> and exposes the base constructors. Methods return futures of EncoderForwardOutput. Detailed behavior and lifecycle (construction parameters, ownership, shutdown) are defined by ReplicaPool; this header does not document them further.
Tracks aggregate execution statistics for translation/scoring runs: total tokens processed, number of examples, and total wall-clock time in milliseconds. Default-initialized to zeros.

High-level API for running sequence-to-sequence translations and scoring. Manages a pool of models::SequenceToSequenceReplica via ReplicaPool and exposes synchronous and asynchronous batch operations and file-based translation/scoring helpers. Ownership/lifecycle is inherited from ReplicaPool; this class does not introduce additional owned resources beyond method-local allocations.

functions.name: ctranslate2::dtype_name
functions.description: Returns the symbolic name of a DataType as a string (e.g., FLOAT32 -> "float32"). Typical usage: for logging, diagnostics, or serialization where a human-readable type name is needed. Exact string format/casing is unknown from the header.
requirements: type must be a valid ctranslate2::DataType enumerator

functions.name: ctranslate2::is_float_type
functions.description: Returns true if the given DataType is a floating-point type (e.g., FLOAT32, FLOAT16, BFLOAT16), false otherwise. Useful for guarding code paths that assume floating-point arithmetic. The precise set considered floating is inferred from enum values.
requirements: type must be a valid ctranslate2::DataType enumerator

functions.name: ctranslate2::str_to_compute_type
functions.description: Parses a string token into a ComputeType enumerator. Use to convert user or config input to an internal ComputeType. Accepted strings and case-sensitivity are unknown from the header.
requirements: compute_type must be a string representing a supported compute type token; exact accepted values and case rules are unknown

functions.name: ctranslate2::compute_type_to_str
functions.description: Converts a ComputeType enumerator to its string representation for logging or serialization. Exact string format/casing is unknown from the header.
requirements: compute_type must be a valid ctranslate2::ComputeType enumerator

functions.name: ctranslate2::mayiuse_bfloat16
functions.signature: bool ctranslate2::mayiuse_bfloat16(const ctranslate2::Device device, const int device_index = 0)
functions.description: Returns whether BFLOAT16 computation is supported/available on the given device (and device index). Intended to gate selection of BFLOAT16 kernels before use.
requirements: device must identify a valid target device type (e.g., CPU/GPU)
device_index selects a specific device instance and should refer to an existing device on the host; valid range is unknown

functions.description: Returns whether FLOAT16 (FP16) computation is supported/available on the given device (and device index). Use to conditionally enable FP16 paths.
requirements: device must identify a valid target device type
device_index should refer to an existing device; valid range is unknown

functions.description: Returns whether INT16 computation is supported/available on the given device (and device index). Use before selecting INT16 kernels/paths.
requirements: device must identify a valid target device type
device_index should refer to an existing device; valid range is unknown

functions.signature: bool ctranslate2::mayiuse_int8(const ctranslate2::Device device, const int device_index = 0)
functions.description: Returns whether INT8 computation is supported/available on the given device (and device index). Use before selecting INT8 kernels/paths.
requirements: device must identify a valid target device type
device_index should refer to an existing device; valid range is unknown

functions.name: ctranslate2::resolve_compute_type
functions.signature: ctranslate2::ComputeType ctranslate2::resolve_compute_type(const ctranslate2::ComputeType requested_compute_type, const ctranslate2::ComputeType model_compute_type, const ctranslate2::Device device, const int device_index = 0, const bool enable_fallback = false)
functions.description: Returns the final compute type based on model weights and device information. Typically used to select the effective precision/quantization at runtime, considering the user request, model’s native type, device capabilities, and optional fallback to a supported type if the requested type is unavailable.
requirements: requested_compute_type must be a valid ctranslate2::ComputeType enumerator
model_compute_type must be a valid ctranslate2::ComputeType enumerator (represents the model’s weight/compute type)
device must identify a valid target device; capabilities are used to decide availability
device_index should refer to an existing device; valid range is unknown
If enable_fallback is false and the requested type is unsupported, behavior is unknown from the header (could error or return a specific type)

functions.name: ctranslate2::data_type_to_compute_type
functions.signature: ctranslate2::ComputeType ctranslate2::data_type_to_compute_type(const ctranslate2::DataType weight_type, const ctranslate2::DataType float_type)
functions.description: Maps the compute type from or to the weights data type. Use to determine an overall ComputeType from a pair describing the model’s weight type and the floating point type used for activations/accumulation. Exact mapping rules are not specified in the header.
requirements: weight_type must be a valid ctranslate2::DataType enumerator
float_type must be a valid ctranslate2::DataType enumerator; typically expected to be a floating type, but this is not enforced by the header

functions.name: ctranslate2::compute_type_to_data_type
functions.description: Maps a ComputeType to the corresponding pair of data types (usually weight type and floating-point type). Useful for configuring tensors and kernels based on a chosen compute mode. Exact mapping is not specified in the header.
requirements: compute_type must be a valid ctranslate2::ComputeType enumerator

functions.name: ctranslate2::get_default_float_type
functions.description: Gets the default floating-point DataType for the given compute type (e.g., may return FLOAT32 for DEFAULT or AUTO). Intended to choose accumulation/activation precision. Exact defaults are not specified in the header.
requirements: compute_type must be a valid ctranslate2::ComputeType enumerator

functions.name: ctranslate2::get_preferred_size_multiple
functions.signature: ctranslate2::dim_t ctranslate2::get_preferred_size_multiple(const ctranslate2::ComputeType compute_type, const ctranslate2::Device device, const int device_index = 0)
functions.description: Gets the preferred size multiple for this compute type on a specific device. Use it to pad tensor dimensions to improve performance or satisfy kernel alignment constraints. The meaning of the returned multiple and whether it is mandatory or just optimal is not specified in the header.
requirements: compute_type must be a valid ctranslate2::ComputeType enumerator
device must identify a valid target device
device_index should refer to an existing device; valid range is unknown

functions.name: ctranslate2::str_to_device
functions.description: Converts a device string (e.g., "cpu", "cuda") to the corresponding ctranslate2::Device enum. Use this to parse user/config-provided device identifiers into the typed Device value.
requirements: Argument device must be a recognized device string for this library (e.g., typically "cpu" or "cuda").
If an unrecognized string is provided, the function may throw (stdexcept is included); callers should be prepared to handle exceptions.

functions.name: ctranslate2::device_to_str
functions.description: Converts a Device enum to a canonical string name. Useful for logging and user-visible messages.
requirements: Argument device must be a valid ctranslate2::Device value.

functions.name: ctranslate2::device_to_str
functions.description: Returns a string representation of a device with an explicit device index (e.g., "cuda:0"). Intended for contexts where the device instance must be identified.
requirements: Argument device must be a valid ctranslate2::Device value.
Argument index should refer to an existing device instance for the given device type (typically 0 <= index < get_device_count(device)).
Callers should ensure index is non-negative.

functions.name: ctranslate2::get_device_count
functions.description: Returns the number of available devices for the given device type (e.g., number of CUDA GPUs).
requirements: Argument device must be a valid ctranslate2::Device value.
For device types that are not available on the running system, the return value may be 0; callers should handle 0 safely.

functions.name: ctranslate2::get_device_index
functions.description: Returns the current active device index for the given device type.
requirements: Argument device must be a valid ctranslate2::Device value.
The returned index, if used, should be validated against get_device_count(device) before use.

functions.name: ctranslate2::set_device_index
functions.description: Sets the current active device index for the given device type. Use to switch the active device (e.g., select a GPU).
requirements: Argument device must be a valid ctranslate2::Device value.
Argument index must designate an existing device for the given type (typically 0 <= index < get_device_count(device)).
Changing the active device may affect subsequent device-bound operations; callers should ensure no incompatible in-flight operations depend on the previous device.

functions.name: ctranslate2::synchronize_device
functions.description: Synchronizes the specified device, blocking until all pending work on that device has completed. On CPU this is typically a no-op; on CUDA it waits for the device to finish pending tasks.
requirements: Argument device must be a valid ctranslate2::Device value.
Argument index must be a valid device index for the given device type (typically 0 <= index < get_device_count(device)).
Calling this may block the calling thread until completion of device work.

functions.name: ctranslate2::synchronize_stream
functions.description: Synchronizes the current stream for the given device. On CUDA, waits for the active stream to complete; on CPU this is typically a no-op.
requirements: Argument device must be a valid ctranslate2::Device value.
The notion of a current/active stream must be properly established for the given device before calling; otherwise behavior is unknown.
Calling this may block the calling thread until completion of stream work.

functions.name: ctranslate2::ScopedMPISetter::ScopedMPISetter
functions.description: RAII constructor that sets up process-wide MPI/distributed rank context for ctranslate2, and possibly initializes NCCL communication when built with tensor parallel support. Creates a scoped lifetime during which ranks/communicators are valid.
requirements: Must be called in a process where the distributed environment is expected to be available; specific initialization requirements are unknown from this header.
If multiple instances are created, interaction between them is unspecified; prefer one instance per process unless the implementation documents otherwise.
When compiled with CT2_WITH_TENSOR_PARALLEL, underlying NCCL prerequisites (e.g., compatible environment variables, drivers) must be satisfied.

functions.name: ctranslate2::ScopedMPISetter::~ScopedMPISetter
functions.description: RAII destructor that tears down the rank/communication context established by ScopedMPISetter. Called automatically when the object goes out of scope.
requirements: Do not destroy the object while operations depending on the established communication context are still in flight; exact constraints are unknown from this header.
Destruction should occur in the same process context as construction.

functions.name: ctranslate2::ScopedMPISetter::getNRanks
functions.description: Returns the total number of ranks (world size) known to the runtime.
requirements: Should be called after the distributed context has been initialized (e.g., after constructing ScopedMPISetter); exact initialization requirements are not specified.
Callers should handle non-positive or unexpected values defensively since exact semantics are not specified in this header.

functions.name: ctranslate2::ScopedMPISetter::getCurRank
functions.description: Returns the current process rank (global rank) within the world.
requirements: Should be called after the distributed context has been initialized (e.g., after constructing ScopedMPISetter); exact initialization requirements are not specified.

functions.name: ctranslate2::ScopedMPISetter::getLocalRank
functions.description: Returns the local rank of the current process (e.g., rank within the current node).
requirements: Should be called after the distributed context has been initialized (e.g., after constructing ScopedMPISetter); exact initialization requirements are not specified.

functions.name: ctranslate2::ScopedMPISetter::finalize
functions.description: Finalizes and cleans up distributed/MPI-related resources tracked by ScopedMPISetter. Intended to be called once when distributed operations are no longer needed.
requirements: Should only be called after initialization has occurred; calling before initialization is unspecified.
Should only be called when no other threads or operations are using the distributed communication context; exact constraints are not specified.
If using CT2_WITH_TENSOR_PARALLEL, callers should ensure NCCL resources are quiesced before finalization.

functions.name: compute_size
functions.description: Computes the total number of elements implied by a shape by multiplying all dimensions. Use to get the flat size for allocation or iteration.
requirements: shape may be empty; in that case the returned size is 1 (neutral element of multiplication).
All dimensions in shape are expected to be non-negative (inferred from common tensor semantics).

functions.name: compute_stride
functions.signature: inline ctranslate2::dim_t compute_stride(const ctranslate2::Shape& shape, ctranslate2::dim_t dim)
functions.description: Computes the contiguous row-major stride (number of elements to skip) for the given dimension in the provided shape. For the last dimension the stride is 1.
requirements: dim must satisfy 0 <= dim < shape.size().
shape may be empty only if callers do not request a stride; passing any dim in that case is invalid (inferred).

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::dtype

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::reserved_memory
functions.description: Returns the amount of allocated memory (in elements or bytes depending on implementation) currently reserved for the storage. The content may be uninitialized after some operations (e.g., reserve).

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::clear

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::release

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::reserve

requirements: If dim < 0, it is interpreted as rank() + dim.

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::resize

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::shrink

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::sync_copy

The StorageView must contain at least one element to dereference the returned pointer.

functions.name: ctranslate2::StorageView::as_scalar

requirements: v may be empty.
repeats >= 0 (size_t). If repeats == 0, the result is empty.

functions.name: ctranslate2::get_batch_results_helper
functions.signature:
template <typename Result, typename SkipRun, typename GetBatchResults>
std::vector<Result> ctranslate2::get_batch_results_helper(size_t batch_size, const SkipRun& skip_run, const GetBatchResults& get_batch_results);
functions.description: Helper to compute batched results while skipping items that already have an immediate result. For each index i in [0, batch_size), it calls skip_run(i, final_results[i]); if skip_run returns false, i is queued. If any indices are queued, get_batch_results(index_to_run) is called and its returned results are placed back into final_results at the corresponding indices. Intended usage: avoid running a model on inputs for which results are already available (e.g., cached or trivial cases).
requirements: batch_size may be 0, in which case an empty vector is returned.

SkipRun must be callable as bool(size_t index, Result& out_result_like), where it may optionally write out_result_like and returns true to indicate the result was produced and running can be skipped; returns false to indicate the item requires processing.
GetBatchResults must be callable as std::vector<Result>(const std::vector<size_t>& indices) and must return a vector whose size equals indices.size(); results[i] corresponds to indices[i].
Both callables should be exception-safe for the caller’s use; this helper does not handle exceptions.
Result must be MoveInsertable/Assignable as the helper assigns/moves results into the output vector.

requirements: y must not be 0 (division by zero is undefined).

T must support +, -, and / operations without overflow on (x + y - 1).

functions.name: ctranslate2::Vocabulary::contains

functions.name: ctranslate2::Vocabulary::to_token

If 'allow_unk' is false, the caller should ensure the token exists in the vocabulary (use contains) to avoid unspecified behavior on unknown tokens (unknown whether an error is raised).

functions.name: ctranslate2::Vocabulary::size

functions.signature: std::vector<std::vector<size_t>> ctranslate2::Vocabulary::to_ids(const std::vector<std::vector<std::string>>& batch_tokens, const size_t max_length = 0, const bool add_bos = false, const bool add_eos = false) const

functions.name: ctranslate2::Vocabulary::unk_token
